counterfactual_missing_items: Fungal hyphae, necrosis, or angioinvasive fungal elements are not described
Granulomatous inflammation or cavernous sinus involvement is not described
Neutrophilic suppurative exudate or abscess formation is not described
decisive_items: Dense infiltrate of IgG-containing plasma cells, with most being IgG4 positive
response.rationale: R3 is the only candidate integrating elevated serum IgG4, IgG4-predominant tissue plasmacytosis, and right sinonasal/orbital-apex involvement. R2 matches the aggressive sinus/apex imaging but fails on cause and pathology, as no fungal elements are described and the culture is bacterial; R1 lacks sinusopathy and granulomatous histology; R4 has a positive culture but cannot explain the IgG4-predominant plasma cell infiltrate.

rejected.why: Painful orbital apex involvement overlaps, but right pan-sinus opacification and bony erosion are atypical for Tolosa-Hunt, and no granulomatous inflammation is described.
A positive Streptococcus constellatus culture is nonspecific in this setting and does not account for the elevated serum IgG4 or the dense IgG4-predominant plasma cell infiltrate.
